verdict.rationale: GrowthBook SDKs download a ruleset subset from the SDK Connection Endpoint, "just enough for the GrowthBook SDKs to assign values to users". Targeting conditions are evaluated in the SDK against locally held attributes that are never sent to GrowthBook. Server-side inline experiments "require no 3rd party requests", and the Proxy caches SDK payloads and keeps serving flags if the API is down. Together this shows local evaluation with no network call per flag check. Missing for 10: explicit latency or microsecond-performance figures, server-SDK-specific docs on in-memory caching and refresh behavior, and independent hands-on corroboration.
